# Image alt text

An inline image with alt text: ![a diagram of the flow](diagram.png).

An inline image with alt text and a title: ![a diagram](diagram.png "The flow").

A reference image: ![a screenshot][shot] in a sentence.

A collapsed reference image: ![a screenshot][] in a sentence.

An image with no alt text: ![](spacer.png).

An image whose alt carries markup: ![an *emphasised* caption](caption.png).

An image inside a link: [![a badge](badge.svg)](https://example.com).

- ![in a list item](item.png)

> ![in a blockquote](quote.png)

[a screenshot]: screenshot.png
